import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int n, x, a, b;
    
    static void read_and_update(int i, Scanner sc) {
        if (i >= n) return;
        x = sc.nextInt();
        if (i == 0) {
            a = b = x;
        } else {
            if (x < a) a = x;
            if (x > b) b = x;
        }
        read_and_update(i + 1, sc);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        read_and_update(0, sc);
        System.out.print((a + b) / 2);
        sc.close();
    }
}
